title: refactor(ci): consolidate lint/test/release workflows and upgrade actions + deps hygiene
author: Priya Nair
description: Motivation: The repo has accumulated many overlapping GitHub Actions workflows (lint, test, release) across services and packages. This PR consolidates and simplifies workflows to reduce duplication, improve cache hit rates, and speed up the PR feedback loop. Key changes: - Split lint/test/release responsibilities into focused workflows with shared reusable jobs (composite actions) and a centralized caching strategy. - Consolidated Node version matrix to Node 20 where possible, while keeping Node 18 compatibility checks for affected packages. - Bumped commonly-used actions (checkout/setup-node/cache) to the latest stable versions and fixed breaking option changes. - Reduced duplicated matrix permutations across packages by moving per-package matrices into generated job matrices for monorepo packages. - Repaired flaky test runners by increasing retry counts and making certain integration tests gate on ephemeral resources. Checklist: - [x] Consolidate workflows into .github/workflows/{lint.yml,test.yml,release.yml} - [x] Introduce .github/actions/ci-cache and .github/actions/reusable-jobs for shared logic - [x] Upgrade GH Actions versions and node setup - [x] Validate on a CI run and iterate on cache keys - [x] Update docs/CONTRIBUTING.md to reflect new CI commands Rollout notes: this is a repo-hygiene change intended to be behavior-preserving for developers; release automation is unchanged functionally but the workflow file is simplified. See commits and changed files for more details.
commits: squash: consolidate workflows and add reusable composite actions
chore(ci): add ci-cache composite action and central cache key strategy
fix(ci): adjust test retry/backoff to reduce flakes in perf-canary integration tests
docs: update CONTRIBUTING.md and CI section
review_comments: Alex Mercer (review): Nice consolidation. Two requests: (1) can we avoid running lint twice on the same matrix by ensuring lint job is only for changed packages, and (2) please add a short note on cache key collision strategy?

Priya Nair (author): Good points — updated lint.yml to gate lint on changed-files using changed-files action and expanded the cache key to include workflow file sha. See commit 'chore(ci): gate lint on changed files and expand cache key'.
Diego Alvarez (review): Left a small nit on the reusable action inputs naming; otherwise LGTM. Verified test workflow run is faster (~22% median) on small PRs.
Maya Chen (approval): Approving after CI green. Observability team to monitor release workflow on next deploy to ensure tags and changelog generation are unaffected.
ci_summary: Initial run: failed due to stale cache key format (actions/cache v4) -> fixed, rerun passed. Overall PR reduces average lint/test workflow run time by ~18% in our sampling.
release_notes: Consolidated CI workflows, upgraded GH Actions to v4, introduced reusable composite actions for caching and common jobs, improved CI latency and reduced duplication. No functional product changes.
